reporting-org.narrative: GHANA NETHERLANDS BUSINESS AND CULTURE COUNCIL

description.narrative: The GNBCC SME Support Desk is a strategic initiative under the Private Sector Development (PSD) Projects. The program provides specialized consultancy to Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) within Ghana’s horticulture and cocoa sectors. Support is concentrated in three critical operational pillars: Marketing and Communications, Accounting and Bookkeeping, and Human Resources. The program operates on a two month cycle per cohort. It offers tailored interventions designed to help SMEs formalize their operations, scale their production, and enhance their overall market competitiveness. The inaugural cohort commenced in August 2025 and concluded in October 2025. This pilot phase consisted of five selected SMEs distributed across the three focus desks, ensuring high-impact, hands-on mentorship.
